lead.description: mean-zero restrictions on the data and a parameter, solved in the sample to produce an estimator

overview_sentence: Estimating equations are mean-zero restrictions whose sample version is solved for a parameter.

self_checks.title: Sample mean
self_checks.prompt: Observations 2, 4, and 6. What solves the sum of (y minus mu) equals 0?

self_checks.title: A second sample
self_checks.prompt: Observations 1, 3, and 8. What solves the same estimating equation?

self_checks.title: A second moment
self_checks.prompt: At mu = 4 for observations 1, 3, and 8, is the average of y squared minus (mu squared + 1) equal to zero?
self_checks.answer: No. The average is 74/3 minus 17, about 7.667.
